newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks hit new records in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks hit new records in afternoon.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index extended its gains in Friday afternoon trade, rallying to a new record high as Hang Seng Bank powered ahead.
The Hang Seng Index was up 554 points, or 3.83 percent, at 15,061.
"Fair value is around 15,000 and generally I think it will stay above 15,000 going through to the handover," said Jake van der Kamp, investment strategist at HG Asia.
Hang Seng Bank gained HK$10.75 to HK$107.50 on talk that a mainland company could buy a stake in the bank.
